h: The Light of Shabbos and the Future Feast

p: "When His lamp shone over my head"
as referring to a fetus in its mother's womb,
that a lamp is lit for it over its head,
and it gazes and looks by it
from one end of the world to the other.
And in this same language it is stated (Chagigah 12a)
about the light that was created on the first day:
from one end of the world to the other, etc.
כֵּיוָן שֶׁנִּסְתַּכֵּל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא וְכוּלֵּי
Once HaKadosh Baruch Hu looked, etc.,
He arose and hid it from them.
And for whom did He hide it?
For the tzaddikim in the time to come,
וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים אֶת הָאוֹר כִּי טוֹב
'And God saw the light, that it was good';
and 'good' means nothing but the tzaddik," etc.
where it does not yet have the yetzer hara
for the yetzer hara rules from the time of emergence,
while the soul is given from the time of conception,
it too is in the aspect of a tzaddik;
therefore a lamp is lit over its head,
and it gazes and looks by it
from one end of the world to the other,
דְּאִיתָא בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב פח, ב)
as is stated in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 88b):
"a soul in which there is all perfection,
in the likeness of the World to Come;
and therefore it is called Shabbos"
like the tzaddikim in the time to come.
And this is "that shines upon our heads,"
like a fetus in its mother's womb.
the Arizal, of blessed memory, reckoned
as corresponding to Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
who is the guest of this meal;
to be circumcised at eight days.
"'And the child grew and was weaned' (Bereishis 21:8)
to make a feast for the tzaddikim
on the day that He bestows His kindness
upon the seed of Yitzchak," etc.
"The Great One of the worlds was there."
And "Great One of the worlds" in the language of the Midrash
in the language of the Zohar.
or "great" and "exalted" and the like do not apply;
but from the side of man,
is designated by the name Arich Anpin,
or by the aspect of "great" and "exalted" and the like.
that there is of His middos,
designated by the name Ze'ir Anpin.
And Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
who was the first circumcised at eight days,
שֶׁהֲרֵי עַל יְדֵי שֶׁנִּימּוֹל לִשְׁמוֹנָה יָמִים
for through being circumcised at eight days
one becomes in the aspect of a tzaddik,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב כג, א)
meaning that he is bound at the root
of "The Great One of the worlds was there."
And therefore it is expounded from this
about the feast of HaKadosh Baruch Hu
for the tzaddikim in the time to come.
And it is stated in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 14b):
Yitzchak in the secret of Tevunah,
Yaakov in the secret of Daas";
(כְּמוֹ דְּאִיתָא בְּפֶתַח אֵלִיָּהוּ) (תִּיקּוּנֵי זֹהַר, הַקְדָּמָה יז, א)
(as is stated in Pesach Eliyahu) (Tikkunei Zohar, Introduction 17a).
for the creation of the world,
so that there be a grasp of Him,
for Hashem Yisbarach emanated the middos
And he reckoned "Binah is the heart":
just as in the heart there are two chambers,
"the heart of the wise man at his right
and the heart of a fool at his left" (Koheles 10:2),
כֵּן בָּרָא הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה
so Hashem Yisbarach created in this world
that there be in it free choice,
and man must choose the good,
He already has angels in Heaven
And this is what it says (Kiddushin 30b):
"and I created the Torah as its antidote";
is that they subdue it and humble it,
And regarding the angels, who have no choice,
"Is there a yetzer hara among you?"
And Yitzchak, who was the first
and born in the holiness of Yisrael,
who is "the heart of the fool,"
to uproot the name Yisrael from himself.
Nevertheless he is called "an apostate Jew,"
but it was in his power
to uproot the name Yisrael from himself,
and he is not included in
the seed of Avraham and Yitzchak,
"'In Yitzchak' — and not all of Yitzchak."
This is not so with the seed of Yaakov,
that even if he increases sins,
the name Yisrael is not uprooted from him,
they shall inherit the land forever."
And in the holy Zohar (Zohar I 93a):
Are there not many guilty ones
and he is included among those who have a share in the World to Come.
And this is why it says:
which is the inner dimension of Keser Elyon.

p: וּבְמִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ (דְּבָרִים רַבָּה א, יט)
And in the Midrash Rabbah on this parshah (Devarim Rabbah 1:19):
'He stores up sound wisdom for the upright,'" etc.
"He stores up sound wisdom for the upright"
and it is from the primordial light,
which was hidden away for those who toil in Torah she'b'al peh.
And this is the meaning of
that is, when the heart has become straight,
that is, when the yetzer hara is uprooted
And this is what is said (Tehillim 31:20):
which You have hidden away for those who fear You":
for the essence of the primordial light
is hidden away for the tzaddikim for the time to come;
וְהוּא כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמַר (קֹהֶלֶת רַבָּה ב, א)
and it is as it says (Koheles Rabbah 2:1):
that a person learns in this world
compared with the Torah of the World to Come";
for the essential revelation of Torah she'b'al peh
What is the matter of the feast
that HaKadosh Baruch Hu is destined to make
That the essential secrets will be revealed
which were not revealed to man
from the day the world was created,
and they will be revealed in the time to come;
and this is the matter of the wine preserved
in its grapes since the six days of Creation.
דְּאִיתָא (תִּיקּוּנֵי זֹהַר תִּיקּוּן מח; בִּדְפוּס וִילְנָא פה, א)
as is stated (Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 48; Vilna edition 85a):
"Fortunate is he who makes a dwelling for them
on Shabbos in the two chambers of the heart,
and the yetzer hara is cleared out from there"
one also merits the primordial light,
as is written in Sefer HaBahir.
אַךְ זֶה הוּא רַק לְפִי שָׁעָה
and "a semblance of the World to Come,"
one sixtieth of the World to Come,
for one tastes a semblance of the future.
are likened to Shabbosos and Yamim Tovim
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג קכד, ב)
in the labor of Torah she'b'al peh;
referring to those who toil in Torah she'b'al peh
to taste a semblance of the World to Come.
And this is what is said:
"He stores up sound wisdom for the upright";
and it is from the "dew of Atika,"
